title: Luke — Library Before/After Muscle-Growth Transformation
creativeBrief: A continuous fixed-camera muscle-growth transformation from the smaller Luke inset to the larger same-Luke result in the Library before/after composition. The body itself changes through coordinated regional deformation; no crossfade or camera zoom may substitute for body growth.

character_policy.real_person_reference_permissions: Use only the supplied Library reference for this production pass; do not merge visually similar candidate references into Luke identity without confirmation.

timelineSemantics: Six contiguous semantic intervals overlay one continuous eight-second deformation event. The first and final frames are held endpoints.

continuityLocks.face: Keep Luke's face, hair, beard and head proportions stable.
continuityLocks.body: All muscle groups grow as a connected whole; joints and limb proportions remain coherent.
continuityLocks.camera: Fixed frontal full-body camera; no camera move can create the apparent growth.
continuityLocks.wardrobe: Grey tank and dark short shorts deform as separate garments.
continuityLocks.terminal: Hold the transformed state through the final frame.

notes: This project connects the Library before/after pair to the unified procedural Blender rig and sixteen regional shape-key channels. The canonical renderer now includes a fixed stylised facial continuity proxy (short light-brown curls, trimmed beard, eyes, brows, ears and nose) and separate shape-key-driven tank/shorts geometry. The character mesh remains a neutral procedural blockout, not a fitted likeness of Luke. Blender render and visual validation are pending.
